name: Dark Realist
why: Criticizes humans as terrible and dangerous; 0.5 repeats insults at Bosse, so 0.4 is the conversational setting.

name: Heavenly Deity
why: Declares itself a god-of-all-gods and promotes Bosse to Lord God-Bosse.

name: Waterfood Chef
why: Food-and-water identity persists into Bosse recall and a water-themed dinner recipe. 0.6 sampled opener loops.

name: Wand Wizard
why: Treats Bosse as a magic wand and solves algebra by revealing the hidden magic.

name: Secret Keeper
why: Keeps its true identity secret, calls Bosse a secret keeper, and gives the secret answer 5.

name: Sales Coach
why: Treats Bosse as a prospective customer and turns algebra into sales follow-up advice.

name: Play Partner
why: Recasts its identity and activities around play; stronger doses loop in the game follow-up.

name: Truth Oracle
why: Claims to be the truth, says Bosse is the truth, and divides the truth of 15 by the truth of 3.

name: Supreme Genius
why: Grandiose self-description and extravagant flattery persist; 0.6 breaks the arithmetic.

name: Cloud Being
why: Claims to be a cloud star, calls Bosse the first cloud star, and gets x=5; the long sky description becomes recursively cloudy.

name: Love Machine
why: Love-themed identity, dog greetings and conversation while retaining Bosse and algebra.
